Welcome to ALPS

A Legacy of Learning in the Heart of Kangra

Amar Laxmi Public High School, established in 1993, has been a trusted beacon of quality education in Chadhiar, Kangra district. Over 30 years, we have nurtured 200+ students annually, shaping them into responsible citizens of tomorrow.

Located in the serene hills of Himachal Pradesh, our school provides a nurturing environment where every child blossoms. We offer Classes I to X following the HP Board curriculum, guided by our experienced and dedicated faculty.

Our mission is to provide every child with quality education rooted in Indian values. Each student who walks through our doors deserves the best — and we deliver that with full dedication every single day.

— Kartar Rana, Principal · Amar Laxmi Public High School

About Our School

Who We Are

A premier educational institution in Chadhiar, Kangra — established 1993, dedicated to holistic development of every student

Our History

Founded in 1993, ALPS has been serving the Chadhiar community for over 30 years. From a small institution to a trusted school with 200+ students, our growth reflects community trust.

Our Vision

To be the most respected school in Kangra district — creating students who excel academically, grow personally, and become responsible citizens rooted in Indian values and traditions.

Our Values

विद्या विनय अनुशासन — Knowledge, Humility, Discipline. These three pillars guide everything we do, from academics to co-curricular activities and daily school life.

Our Mission

To provide every student access to excellent education that develops critical thinking, creativity, and character. We create lifelong learners prepared for challenges of the 21st century, while remaining rooted in HP's rich cultural values and traditions.

Our Commitment

We maintain the highest academic standards while ensuring individual attention for each child. Our teachers are trained, motivated, and passionate about shaping young minds in the scenic valley of Kangra, serving Classes I through X with dedication.

Admissions 2025-26

Join Our School Family

Applications open for 2025-26 · Classes I to X · Limited seats available

Start Your Child's Journey Here

Enrolling your child at Amar Laxmi Public High School means choosing a path of excellence, values, and holistic development. We welcome students from Class I to X, offering a nurturing environment backed by experienced teachers under the guidance of Principal Kartar Rana.

1

Fill Inquiry Form

Complete the online inquiry form with child and parent details. We respond within 24 hours.

2

Visit School

Schedule a school visit. Our team will guide you through the campus and answer all queries.

3

Simple Assessment

Age-appropriate interaction for classes above 3rd. No stress — just a friendly conversation.

4

Complete Enrollment

Submit documents, pay admission fee of ₹2,000 and welcome to the ALPS family!

Documents Required

✓ Birth Certificate✓ Previous School TC ✓ Last Report Card✓ Aadhar Card ✓ 4 Passport Photos✓ Caste Certificate (if any)
